notes: textures/slai/shops/mak02_1.png and mak04_1.png: the S.L.A.I. dealers OMSK's and S&V Ma.FABRIK's logos. OMSK's crescent and swooshes are traced from the art (each colour where its coverage crosses half, smoothed); its block lettering is exact geometry, every edge measured from the art and the outer corners true arcs, with the trace kept only to cast its shadow. Ma.FABRIK's square, V and bars are a rounded box and measured polygons, the bars' hidden ends under the V; its wordmarks and both subtitles are live text (sprite_text.json). Each path is a class, drawn first as the soft drop shadow (3, 5 texels down-right, solid at the edge and fading over 10) and then in its colour.

Plain frames and cursors the menus draw from their atlases, redrawn as rounded-rectangle outlines at the output resolution while sharp text is on (settings), instead of the atlas art stretched and filtered. Each shape is found by its sprite's image and rect, wherever a screen draws it; anything not listed, and all painted art, is drawn from the atlas.

An outline is a rounded rectangle (box: LTRB in the sprite's texels, relative to its rect; radius in texels) coloured by distance from its edge: stops are [distance, colour, alpha], negative inside. Two stops at one distance are a hard edge, antialiased over one screen pixel. The first stop's colour fills the inside (alpha 0 leaves it empty); nothing is drawn past the last. radius_growth (default 1) is how much the corner radius grows per texel of distance, for rings rounder inside than out. count and step repeat an outline over a grid of cells. Outlines draw in order. fill is a gradient for the inside, {axis: "y" or "x", stops: [[position, colour], ...]} in texels along that axis. A path (SVG M/L/C/Q... closed contour in the same texels, moved by offset [dx, dy]) replaces box and radius for shapes that are not rounded rectangles; distances then run from the path, each point moved along its corner's bisector. Further contours in a path are holes (a letter's counters), and a path of any shape fills; a distance deeper than a corner's radius folds there, so deep rings are separate outlines on their own inner contours. shade_toward [x, y] shades a bevel: stops then take [distance, colour, alpha, shade colour, shade alpha], and each point of the edge blends to the shade colour as the edge faces that direction (an edge across it takes half).

Geometry is measured from the art (each edge where its alpha crosses half, each corner from its diagonal); the original's three-texel soft edges are drawn as hard edges at that point, keeping their darker rim as a one-texel band.

classes work as in sprite_text.json: a shape or outline naming a class takes its keys unless it sets them. A fill stop may take an alpha, [position, colour, alpha], for gradients that fade out. A shape with a "trace" ({colour, tolerance, min_line, within}) and no outlines is given one box per ruled line of that colour by tools/sprite_lettering.py measure. A sprite_text.json entry with art false on the same sprite draws neither the atlas art nor its shape, only the text.

record_tex [0,480,432,624] and [432,480,864,624]: RECORDS' venue and REGULATION grids (0x33660, 0x3472d), lines 6.3 texels wide every 62. Each cell's white ring is drawn first, then the frame, then the cells' rims, so no ring covers another's rim.
record_tex [1928,304,2008,384] and [864,480,1008,624]: the grid's cursor and the area ranker's cursor, an orange ring 6.8 texels wide with darker edges.

media_playlist_tex [640,440,696,480] and [1896,288,1952,344]: BGM SELECT's stock slot and program disc, a white rim round a dark fill. [1440,440,1496,480], [920,440,1064,480], [752,440,920,480] and [1312,440,1440,480]: its stock, menu, program and play-mode cursors, a glow along a rounded ring kept as soft as the art; their profiles are sampled from the art a texel apart across the ring's long side.

option_tex OPTION's buttons (VIBRATION, SOUND CONFIG, BUTTON CONFIG, SCREEN ADJUST, DEFAULT, EXIT): a rim 3 texels wide round [11,3,181,33], its corners 6 texels round outside and 3 inside; white round #151515 normally, black round #fcc500 chosen. Their labels (sprite_text.json) are drawn over the outline in place of the erased art.

schedule_tex [520,672,640,712] and [640,672,760,712]: the schedule's EXIT plate, also SKIP TO DAY's: a rim round [10,6,110,30], #151515 in white normally, #fcc500 in black lit. Their lettering is in sprite_text.json.

sound_config_tex [640,344,904,360] and [888,0,896,8]: SOUND CONFIG's volume track (a pale rim, dark and blue grooves and a blue body shaded down its height) and the level bar's segment (white to #262526 down its height).

key_config_tex [992,128,1008,144] and [1008,128,1024,144], [1008,280,1024,296] and [1008,296,1024,312]: BUTTON CONFIG's right and left arrows, plain and lit: a black triangle (a white one inside it when lit) over a soft shadow down and right. The button icons and controller markers stay atlas art.

save_load_tex [640,0,768,152], [896,0,1024,152] and [768,152,896,304]: LOAD/SAVE's folder plates, a path traced from the art's tabbed edge: a cream edge line, a bevel pale to the top left and dark to the bottom right (shade_toward), the body and a soft dark halo. Each bevel step is its own outline on an inner contour of the same path. [768,0,896,152], [640,152,768,304] and [896,152,1024,304]: the chosen plates, a glowing edge, a second glowing ring 9 texels in and the body darkening inward in steps.

Leg module tables (customize_tex [1240,480,1448,608], wild_tex/1 [680,480,888,608], stock_module_tex/0 [864,320,1072,448]): the ruled lines, and a port addition: in place of WEIGHT CAPACITY's repeated WEIGHT, a white arrow (a tapered quarter turn in six pieces and its head) bends down from the WEIGHT row to point at CAPACITY (sprite_text.json), with the labels' drop shadow under it, so the values to the right have room.
